title: Diminished and augmented
raisedBecause: Diminished and augmented chords bring tense sounds and new hand shapes, and come after major and minor chords are secure; the notes alone measure Beginner.
trains: B° (diminished: two minor thirds, B D F) leans into C; C+ (augmented: two major thirds, C E G♯) pushes its G♯ up to A in F. Every finger moves a step at most; the left hand plays the bass.
